entry_thesis: With Iran declaring the Strait of Hormuz closed as of March 4 and US-Israel strikes ongoing (Operation Epic Fury), gold is in a classic geopolitical safe-haven rally. GLD pulled back ~10% from its January ATH of $490+ creating a re-entry opportunity at $471.80. Portfolio has zero gold exposure, making this an excellent diversifier vs existing energy/tech holdings.
risk: Ceasefire or diplomatic resolution could deflate the geopolitical premium rapidly, sending gold back toward $450.
catalyst: Ongoing Strait of Hormuz closure driving oil-inflation-gold feedback loop, plus Fed on hold amid geopolitical uncertainty
